raw_segments.text: Whether fagged by the three days' running chase, and the resistance to his swimming
in the knotted hamper he bore, or whether it was some latent deceitfulness and malice
in him, whichever was true, the white whale's way now began to abate, as it seemed, from
the boat so rapidly nearing him once more, though indeed the whale's last start had
not been so long a one as before.
And still as Ahab glided over the waves, the unpitying sharks accompanied him, and so pertenaciously
stuck to the boat, and so continually bit at the plying oars, that the blades became
jagged and crunched, and left small splinters in the sea at almost every dip.
